ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud in Texas
ideas.description: Investigate the childcare fraud probe in Texas and potential connections to other cases.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records research
questions: What is the extent of childcare fraud in Texas?
Are there connections to other cases or states?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a complex issue. By following the money and analyzing data, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform future investigations.
